name: Argument types the mod reads
description: Sends the mod's message handler, through execute_code, numbers and booleans of the wrong JSON type, a non-integer and an out-of-range value where an integer is meant, a float past the float range, and null optional and required arguments; each wrong type is refused naming the argument before anything acts, and a null reads as absent. The server refuses these before they are sent, so this is the only path that reaches the mod's own reads. Changes nothing in the game.
